items.t: Teradyne Benefits From Strong Test Demand: Can It Beat KLAC & COHU?

items.t: Cathie Wood Dumps the Last of Teradyne From Her Flagship Fund
items.sum: ARK's flagship fund exited a chip-testing stock just as it surged on a fresh Buy rating, and Wood offered no explanation. Another ARK fund still holds millions in shares, so the real question is what happens to that stake next.

items.t: Is It Worth Investing in Teradyne (TER) Based on Wall Street's Bullish Views?
items.sum: The average brokerage recommendation (ABR) for Teradyne (TER) is equivalent to a Buy. The overly optimistic recommendations of Wall Street analysts make the effectiveness of this highly sought-after metric questionable. So, is it worth buying the stock?
